I replied to Dana in your DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 Dana first posted 180 for the amendment signed the day before, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't find the amendment itself in the shared folders. So I told Dana the figure comes from that thread and that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if they want to check it.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to share it.
